title: DPhil in Computer Science
institution: University of Oxford, Department of Computer Science
about: Oxford's DPhil in Computer Science for 2027-28 entry lists about 55 places and an expected start of 10 October 2027. The 2 December 2026 midday deadline is the last for Oxford scholarship consideration; a later deadline of 2 March 2027 is also listed.
requirements: December deadline is the final deadline for Oxford scholarship consideration
A later final application deadline is listed for Tuesday 2 March 2027
Interviews are usually held in January and February for December applicants

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Skill "Computer science research" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

Doctoral level research (DPhil) → objective "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
